title: Ranked preferences for a workshop theme

blocks.text: Every voter submits the complete ranking shown for that group. In each round count each participating voter for their highest-ranked remaining theme. If no theme has more than half the participating votes, eliminate the theme with the fewest votes. Then recount among the two remaining themes; the larger count wins. Assume no ties unless an item explicitly asks about one.
